context: 『今日、好きになりました。』(今日好き) is a Japanese teen dating reality show on ABEMA. Each season ('編') sends single high-school students on a 2-night-3-day 'romantic school trip' (修学旅行) to a domestic or overseas destination. Participants go on one-on-one dates (2ショットトーク), draw lots (花くじ) for groupings, share first impressions and who they like, and on the final day make a confession (告白); mutual feelings form a couple (カップル成立), otherwise some return as 継続メンバー. In-studio, comedian Inoue Yusuke of NON STYLE hosts as the 恋愛見届け人. Speech is earnest, casual high-school Japanese full of romance vocabulary. Produce natural Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) subtitles, keeping the tone youthful and sincere.
